standard_prerequisites.name: The induction principle of the circle
standard_prerequisites.statement: To prove a family over the circle it suffices to give an element over the base point together with a path over the loop between its transports.
standard_prerequisites.use: The whole proof is that induction applied to the family of equalities between the two maps.

standard_prerequisites.name: Transport in path spaces over a loop
standard_prerequisites.statement: The transport of a path between the two values at the base point along the loop, inside the family of equality types, reduces to the given comparison between the two actions on the loop.
standard_prerequisites.use: It is the reduction that turns the loop case into the datum q of the statement.

core_obligations: Apply the induction principle of the circle to the family of types f(x) = g(x) (source line 320).
Supply the base case, which is exactly the given equality p between the two values at the base point (source line 321).

Supply the loop case: the transport of p along the loop inside the family f(x) = g(x), which by the two cited transport results reduces to the given comparison q of the actions on the loop (source lines 322-324).

proof_roadmap.step: Choose the family of equalities and apply circle induction.
Base case p; loop case reduced by transport results to q.

difficulty_reason: Counted unit is the author labelled lemma at source lines 309-318: maps on the circle are determined by the value at the base point together with the action on the loop, in the form that two maps with such comparable data are pointwise equal. The proof (source lines 319-325) is short but it is the actual argument rather than a pointer: it applies the induction principle of the circle to the family of equality types between the two maps, reads off the base case as exactly one of the two given data, and then identifies the loop case with the other datum by reducing a transport in a family of path types through two cited transport results. Choosing the right family and reducing the loop case are the substance, and the statement alone does not display them.
